feeds.description: Check out news about the film, as well as never before revealed crunchy bits about the hidden history of Dungeons & Dragons. Blackmoor is the name of a fictional world created by David Arneson. It is also the prototype of Dungeons & Dragons, the first published role-playing game. Unlike other fantasy worlds, such as J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle Earth, Blackmoor is a living world that is being explored to this day. Secrets of Blackmoor investigates the origins of the role-playing game, through candid interviews, archival footage, and newly discovered artifacts.
